title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in the Balaka, Chikwawa and Machinga districts of Malawi, works towards the goal that poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable livelihoods and diverse food sources. This objective focuses on strengthening the sustainable economic well-being of people living in poverty, especially women and youth. Activities include the provision of training in areas such as VSLAs, financial literacy, market analysis and value chain analysis. The principal focus of this outcome is: • The sustainable economic well-being of people, especially women and youth, through support for savings and credit groups, business and enterprise training and enterprise capital provision, market systems analysis and solidarity local market engagement initiatives.
Capacity strengthening of women and youth, their households and communities is a core element of the approach giving skills to manage finances, group businesses, and to apply product processing and aggregation and marketing technologies.
